poses.name: 01_front_ready
poses.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE full-body alternate portrait for HEXBLADE's diagonal DOCKING fusion cut-in.
The input is a character/style reference. Redraw the SAME character, with a new pose.
Identity: pale mint-green long thick wavy hair with large pointed curls; heavy asymmetric side fringe hiding one eye; one large visible pink/magenta eye with heavy black upper eyelashes; white frilled maid headband; large charcoal bow with pink lining and white flower accessory; black-and-white maid dress, white frilled apron and waist bow, white buttoned cuffs, pink neck bow, white stockings with small black/pink ribbon accents, chunky black buckle shoes. Match the reference's very large head, compact chibi body and fully clothed costume coverage.
Style: bold black outlines, clean chunky shapes, crisp cel shading, muted grey-violet shadows, pale mint/charcoal/white with small pink accents, matching the supplied illustration closely. No 3D rendering, tiny lace detailing, gold trim, redesign or realistic proportions.
Composition: exactly ONE full-body character, portrait canvas, all hair, fingers and shoes fully inside the image, comfortable transparent margin. Actual transparent alpha background, not drawn checkerboard. No scenery, ground shadow, tray, cake, utensils, weapons, other characters, floating props, sparkles, motion lines, light trails, text or watermark. Natural coherent two arms/two hands/two legs, five fingers per hand. Output one pose, not a model sheet.
POSE: confident frontal fusion-ready stance. Both arms firmly crossed in front of the upper chest, elbows opening out sideways and both white cuffs/hands clearly visible. This tight, compact upper-body silhouette must differ strongly from the original hand-at-lips/tray pose and the previous spread-arm jump. Torso faces almost straight toward the viewer, shoulders square. Head slightly cocked and chin raised, playful determined closed smile, large pink eye clearly visible. Both feet planted wide apart with slight outward toes, knees subtly bent, stable grounded stance. Long hair hangs in broad curled masses around both sides, apron flat and readable. Do not raise an arm above the head or jump. Keep arms and face readable at upper-body cut-in crop.
